Hi Contracts team,

We're getting ready to finalize the Order Form for Cloudway (DEAL-2147). Legal asked me to coordinate the insurance evidence handoff so we can close. Two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm your carrier can issue a COI meeting the Order Form minimums: General Liability $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate; Professional Liability $2M?
2) We need either an additional insured endorsement or a carrier letter confirming Additional Insured (AI) for Redwood Inference and its subsidiaries. Preferred endorsement form is ISO CG 20 10 (or equivalent).

I've attached our redlined Order Form and a sample endorsement for reference. Ideally we'd have a draft COI + endorsement by end of week so procurement can complete the checklist.

Attachments: OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (redlines), endorsement_sample.pdf (preferred wording)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Subject: Fwd: Order Form insurance onboarding — recommended acceptance path

Forwarding Cloudway's note. My take from Legal and Risk:

- Naming: accept "Redwood Inference, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates" — that's consistent with our prior practice. No need to list every subsidiary.
- AI endorsement: ask for ISO CG 20 10 or equivalent. If insurer cannot provide that exact form, we will accept carrier-specific AI endorsement subject to Legal sign-off.
- Primary & Non-Contributory: we prefer P&NC for customer-facing production integrations. If carrier objects due to policy form, request a carrier letter confirming they will waive subrogation and accept P&NC for claims arising from the contracted services.
- Retroactive date: only required for claims-made Professional Liability; if they can supply a retro date that predates contract start, that's ideal but not a blocker for signing — track separately.

Action items for procurement (David):
  • Confirm naming to Sanjay (I've already told Legal we're OK with the consolidated naming).
  • Ask broker to push for a true AI endorsement; accept carrier letter only as temporary if endorsement timing blocks deal.
  • Capture final COI and endorsement as PDFs and upload to our Drive link (shared below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cCOIplaybook

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
